skeleton.description: Stands in for content that has not loaded.

spinner.description: Indicates an action in progress with no known duration.

progress.description: Shows how far along a task is.

card.description: Groups related media, content and actions on one surface.

dialog.description: Interrupts with content that requires a response.

segmented.description: Picks one value from a small set of options.
